thread:
mike (SRE): Heads up — SLO alert firing for hosted-infer in us-west2. p99 spiked to ~7.8s and we saw a burst of 502/504/timeouts around 23:40 UTC. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/slo/us-west2/prefetch :warning:

I'm seeing a cluster of failures that look like prefetch stage timeouts (gateway -> runtime prefetch). Anyone oncall?

eva (oncall): I'm on it. Acknowledged alert, starting triage. Pulling logs and traces now.

alice (support): Customer CS-3417 opened a ticket, reporting repeated 504s on POST /v1/generate (req id: req-9a8b). They included a sample request and say it times out consistently. Passing to SRE for root cause.

sam (infra): Copy. Can you paste the request id? I'll also check routing and recent infra changes. Quick log query I ran in loki: 

```
{job="gateway",region="us-west2"} |= "req-9a8b" | json | line_format "{{.level}} {{.msg}} {{.latency_ms}}"
```

sam (infra): Early result: bunch of `prefetch` calls hitting >3000ms and then returning 502 from proxy.

leo (obs): Running trace query across the 23:35-23:50 window. Noticed a sampling change around 23:39 that dropped proxy->runtime spans for many traces — that explains a trace gap. Example trace id: trace-0a1b2c; missing runtime child spans. My traceql query: 

```
traceql
find service=gateway where name="prefetch" and duration>1000 | sort duration desc | limit 20
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v2026.03.15-58 deployed to us-west2 at 2026-03-15T23:39:12Z by sam-ci. Change summary: sampling.default 0.05 -> 0.01 (reduced sampling).

mike (SRE): Reduced sampling would cause the appearance of trace gaps, but our SLOs and customer complaints indicate real user-facing errors (502/504). Two orthogonal issues: sampling hides root cause details; something else caused actual prefetch timeouts. Possible contributors: small batch sizing or a runtime GC/queue pressure window.

mike (SRE): Immediate mitigation options:
- revert sampling to previous 0.05 for visibility
- increase prefetch timeout to 8s temporarily
- route affected customers to dedicated pool or reduce batch_size to limit tail latencies

sam (infra): I'll roll back the sampling change to 0.05 for us-west2 for the next hour and monitor. Pushing rollback now.

eva (oncall): Also created a temporary routing rule for requests tagged customer=CS-3417 -> dedicated-pool-usw2 and reduced gateway.batch_size=8 for that route. Monitoring error rate and p99.

alice (support): Quick repro command the customer provided: 

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"test repeated timeouts"}'
```

alice (support): Customer reports error response: `504 Gateway Timeout` with request id `req-9a8b`. After the routing change they see fewer failures in the last 8 minutes.

leo (obs): After rollback, traces show proxy->runtime spans returning. I can now see long prefetch durations (~3.2s) for a subset of requests that then cause the proxy to surface a 504 when combined with small gateway timeouts. Also saw a runtime-side queue length spike in the same window.

mike (SRE): Good signal. Action items:
- sam: keep sampling at 0.05 (rolled back) and push an observability alert for trace-gap counts.
- leo: add a dashboard panel showing requests with no runtime span and alert when > 1% over 5m.
- eva: keep the temporary routing for CS-3417 until next morning PDT and monitor.
- alice: update customer that we've mitigated and are investigating root cause; ask for any additional request ids.

sam (infra): Rollback complete — infra-config v2026.03.15-59 rolled by sam-ci at 2026-03-15T23:52:45Z. Sampling restored to 0.05.

deploy-bot: Rollout succeeded (no health-check failures).

eva (oncall): Alert cleared — p99 back within target for the last 15 minutes, error rate for CS-3417 dropped to <0.5%. Closing on-call incident but leaving routing rule until morning. :white_check_mark:

alice (support): Customer confirmed reduced errors and appreciates quick response. I'll keep the ticket open and update once we have RCA. :thumbsup:

mike (SRE): Created INC-2026-421 and linked traces/logs + the rollout diff. Putting RCA owner on this; suspect interplay between reduced sampling (visibility loss) and a runtime queue/processing perturbation amplified by gateway timeouts. Follow-up: add runbook step to avoid sampling config changes during SLO burn windows and add automated pre-deploy check for sampling vs monitoring windows.

leo (obs): I'll open a PR to add the trace-gap alert and a short dashboard. Also adding a test that simulates reduced sampling to validate observability thresholds.

mike (SRE): Thanks team — filing for a postmortem if we see recurrence.

(End of thread)
